slides.title: StayBent JaeBee
slides.sub: The most flexible blade in the StayBent range

slides.title: Built for feel and flow
slides.body: The JaeBee is made for skaters who read a corner and skate it with touch, rather than wanting an ultra stiff platform.

slides.title: Flexible lips
slides.body: Its lips flex even more than the StayBent QCS, so the blade follows your foot through the stride instead of fighting it.

slides.title: A tapered tube
slides.sub: More give at the tips, more support in the middle

slides.title: Two steels to choose from
slides.body: Bimetal at 62 HRC is forgiving and easy to sharpen. Full PM at 64 HRC holds an edge longer for skaters who train most days.

slides.title: Eight lengths, 14.5 to 18
slides.body: Shorter blades feel quicker and more agile. Longer blades track straighter and carry more speed on the straights.
